jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Visit in live here : W VERBIER Home

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

As a key member of the Whatever/Whenever team / Guest relations team , you are the behind-the-scenes force that ensures every guest experience runs seamlessly. From managing incoming calls to coordinating guest requests with precision, your role is all about logistics, anticipation, and operational excellence.

You’ll be the central point of contact for guest needs—coordinating with all departments to ensure requests are fulfilled smoothly and proactively identifying opportunities to go above and beyond. Whether it’s a last-minute birthday surprise or a special arrival setup, you’ll have your finger on the pulse of what makes a stay unforgettable.

This role requires a global understanding of hotel operations, strong multitasking abilities, and a natural flair for creating WOW moments—even from behind the scenes.

You don't just react—you anticipate. You don't just complete tasks—you help shape experiences. All while embodying the Whatever/Whenever service philosophy that defines W Hotels

PROFILE

• You are passionate about the W brand and are eager to be part of our team.
 • You have experience in Concierge/ Guest Service department in a high end, lifestyle kind of environment.
 • Fluent in French and English
 • You have a natural affinity to styling trends.
 • You have excellent people skills and have an upbeat, positive attitude to work and life.
 • You are creative and always think of new ways of doing things, you embrace change.
 • You are highly motivated
 • Be detail oriented and have a passion for giving guests an exceptional experience.
 • Real interest in the worlds of taste, sound, body, scene and stance

Position to be filled for the Winter season : December 2026 to March 2027

Due to visa restrictions, only applications from Switzerland and the European Union will be considered

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

descriptionByLocale.it:
DESCRIZIONE DELLA JOB Visita in diretta qui: W VERBIER Home Diventa un talento W e incarna l'arte W di vivere! Come ‘Talent’, siete l’essenza di W per i nostri ospiti. Porti un tocco giocoso, caldo e accogliente che fa la differenza nei nostri hotel W. Siete unici, appassionati e la vostra personalità brilla in ogni interazione. UNA OPPORTUNITÀ ESEPIZIONALE PER IL TEAM VERBIER W! In qualità di membro chiave del team di relazioni con gli ospiti/qualsiasi squadra, sei la forza dietro le quinte che assicura che ogni esperienza degli ospiti funzioni senza soluzione di continuità. Dalla gestione delle chiamate in arrivo al coordinamento delle richieste degli ospiti con precisione, il vostro ruolo è tutto sulla logistica, l'anticipazione e l'eccellenza operativa. Sarete il punto centrale di contatto per le esigenze degli ospiti, coordinando con tutti i dipartimenti per garantire che le richieste siano soddisfatte senza problemi e proattivamente identificando le opportunità di andare oltre e oltre. Che si tratti di una sorpresa di compleanno dell'ultimo minuto o di una speciale configurazione di arrivo, avrai il dito sul polso di ciò che rende un soggiorno indimenticabile. Questo ruolo richiede una comprensione globale delle operazioni alberghiere, forti abilità multitasking, e un tocco naturale per creare momenti WOW, anche dietro le quinte. Non reagisci, ti aspetti. Non si completano solo i compiti: si aiutano a modellare le esperienze. Tutto pur incarnando la filosofia di servizio che definisce W Hotels PROFESSIONALE
• Siete appassionati del marchio W e siete desiderosi di partecipare alla nostra squadra.
• Hai esperienza nel dipartimento Concierge/ Guest Service in un ambiente di alto livello, stile di vita.
• Fluente in francese e inglese
• Hai una naturale affinità con le tendenze stilistiche.
• Hai ottime capacità di persone e hai un atteggiamento ottimista e positivo al lavoro e alla vita.
• Siete creativi e pensate sempre a nuovi modi di fare le cose, abbracciate il cambiamento.
• Sei molto motivato.
• Essere orientati al dettaglio e avere una passione per dare agli ospiti un'esperienza eccezionale.
• Interesse reale nei mondi del gusto, del suono, del corpo, della scena e della posizione Posizione da riempire per la stagione invernale: da dicembre 2026 a marzo 2027 A causa delle restrizioni del visto, solo le domande dalla Svizzera e dall'Unione Europea saranno considerate A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile. La missione degli hotel è quella di accendere la curiosità, i mondi esplosi. Siamo un posto dove vivere la vita. Siamo qui per aprire porte e menti aperte. Siamo costantemente ispirati a nuovi volti e nuove esperienze. Uno spirito sintonizzato, up-for-anything è al nostro centro e ci ha resi noti per reinventare le norme del lusso in tutto il mondo. Qualunque sia la nostra cultura e la nostra filosofia di servizio che anima le passioni dei nostri ospiti. Se siete originali, innovativi e sempre alla ricerca del futuro di ciò che è possibile, benvenuti a W Hotels. Nell'unione di W Hotels, unisciti a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

descriptionByLocale.de:
BESCHREIBUNG Besuchen Sie hier live : W VERBIER Home Werde ein W Talent und verkörpere die W Art of Living! Als „Talent sind Sie die Essenz von W für unsere Gäste. Sie bringen eine spielerische, warme und einladende Note, die den Unterschied in unseren W Hotels macht. Du bist einzigartig, leidenschaftlich und deine Persönlichkeit scheint in jeder Interaktion durch. EINE AUSSERGEWÖHNLICHE Gelegenheit, am W VERBIER-TEAM teilzunehmen! Als ein wichtiges Mitglied des Whatever/Whenever-Teams / Guest Relations-Teams sind Sie die Kraft hinter den Kulissen, die dafür sorgt, dass jedes Gästeerlebnis nahtlos verläuft. Von der Verwaltung eingehender Anrufe bis hin zur präzisen Koordination von Gästeanfragen dreht sich Ihre Rolle um Logistik, Antizipation und operative Exzellenz. Sie sind die zentrale Anlaufstelle für die Bedürfnisse der Gäste - Sie stimmen sich mit allen Abteilungen ab, um sicherzustellen, dass Anfragen reibungslos erfüllt werden und proaktiv Möglichkeiten identifiziert werden, um darüber hinauszugehen. Ob es sich um eine Last-Minute-Geburtstagsüberraschung oder ein spezielles Ankunfts-Setup handelt, Sie werden Ihren Finger am Puls dessen haben, was einen Aufenthalt unvergesslich macht. Diese Rolle erfordert ein globales Verständnis des Hotelbetriebs, starke Multitasking-Fähigkeiten und ein natürliches Flair für die Schaffung von WOW-Momenten - auch hinter den Kulissen. Sie reagieren nicht nur - Sie erwarten. Sie erledigen nicht nur Aufgaben - Sie helfen, Erfahrungen zu gestalten. Alles während die Verkörperung der Whatever/Whenever Service Philosophie, die W Hotels definiert PROFIL
• Sie sind begeistert von der Marke W und möchten Teil unseres Teams sein.
• Sie haben Erfahrung in der Concierge / Guest Service-Abteilung in einer High-End-, Lifestyle-Umgebung.
• Fließend in Französisch und Englisch
• Sie haben eine natürliche Affinität zu Styling-Trends.
• Sie haben ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten und haben eine optimistische, positive Einstellung zu Arbeit und Leben.
• Du bist kreativ und denkst immer an neue Wege, Dinge zu tun, du umarmst Veränderungen.
• Du bist hoch motiviert
• Seien Sie detailorientiert und haben Sie eine Leidenschaft dafür, Ihren Gästen ein außergewöhnliches Erlebnis zu bieten.
• Echtes Interesse an den Welten von Geschmack, Klang, Körper, Szene und Haltung Position für die Wintersaison: Dezember 2026 bis März 2027 Aufgrund von Visabeschränkungen werden nur Anträge aus der Schweiz und der Europäischen Union berücksichtigt Bei Marriott International sind wir bestrebt, ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit zu sein, alle willkommen zu heißen und Zugang zu Chancen zu bieten. Wir fördern aktiv ein Umfeld, in dem die einzigartigen Hintergründe unserer Mitarbeiter geschätzt und gefeiert werden. Unsere größte Stärke liegt in der reichen Mischung aus Kultur, Talent und Erfahrungen unserer Mitarbeiter. Wir verpflichten uns zur Nichtdiskriminierung auf jeder geschützten Grundlage, einschließlich Behinderung, Veteranenstatus oder einer anderen durch geltendes Recht geschützten Grundlage. Die Mission von W Hotels ist es, Curiosity zu entzünden, Welten zu erweitern. Wir sind ein Ort, um das Leben zu erleben. Wir sind hier, um Türen und offene Köpfe zu öffnen. Wir werden ständig von neuen Gesichtern und neuen Erfahrungen inspiriert. Ein abgestimmter, up-for-anything-geist ist in unserem kern und hat uns dafür bekannt gemacht, die normen des luxus auf der ganzen welt neu zu erfinden. Was auch immer unsere Kultur und Servicephilosophie ist, die die Leidenschaften unserer Gäste zum Leben erweckt. Wenn Sie originell, innovativ und immer auf die Zukunft des Möglichen ausgerichtet sind, willkommen in W Hotels. Wenn Sie W Hotels beitreten, schließen Sie sich einem Markenportfolio mit Marriott International an. Seien Sie dort, wo Sie Ihre beste Arbeit leisten, Ihren Zweck beginnen, zu einem erstaunlichen globalen Team gehören und die beste Version von Ihnen werden können.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
DESCRIPTION DE L'EMPLOI Visite en direct ici : W VERBIER Accueil Devenez un W Talent et imaginez l'art de vivre! En tant que « Talent », vous êtes l'essence de W pour nos invités. Vous apportez une touche ludique, chaleureuse et accueillante qui fait toute la différence dans nos hôtels W. Vous êtes unique, passionné, et votre personnalité brille à travers chaque interaction. UNE POSSIBILITÉ EXCEPTIONNELLE DE S'INSCRIRE DANS L'ÉQUIPE W VERBIER ! En tant que membre clé de l'équipe Quoi qu'il en soit / l'équipe de relations avec les invités , vous êtes la force derrière les coulisses qui assure que chaque expérience des invités fonctionne parfaitement. De la gestion des appels entrants à la coordination des demandes des clients avec précision, votre rôle est tout au sujet de la logistique, de l'anticipation et de l'excellence opérationnelle. Vous serez le point de contact central pour les besoins des clients, en coordination avec tous les ministères afin de s'assurer que les demandes sont satisfaites en douceur et de façon proactive en identifiant les possibilités d'aller au-delà. Que ce soit une surprise d'anniversaire de dernière minute ou une configuration d'arrivée spéciale, vous aurez votre doigt sur le pouls de ce qui rend un séjour inoubliable. Ce rôle exige une compréhension globale des opérations hôtelières, de solides capacités de multitâche et un flair naturel pour créer des moments WOW – même en coulisse. Vous ne réagissez pas, vous anticipez. Vous n'accomplissez pas seulement des tâches, vous aidez à façonner les expériences. Tout en incarnant la philosophie du service qui définit W Hotels PROFIL
• Vous êtes passionné par la marque W et êtes impatient de faire partie de notre équipe.
• Vous avez une expérience dans le service Concierge / Guest Service dans un environnement haut de gamme, style de vie.
• Fluent en français et anglais
• Vous avez une affinité naturelle avec les tendances de style.
• Vous avez d'excellentes compétences et avez une attitude positive et optimiste au travail et à la vie.
• Vous êtes créatif et pensez toujours à de nouvelles façons de faire les choses, vous embrassez le changement.
• Vous êtes très motivé
• Être orienté vers le détail et avoir une passion pour donner aux invités une expérience exceptionnelle.
• Un véritable intérêt pour les mondes du goût, du son, du corps, de la scène et de la position Poste à pourvoir pour la saison d'hiver : décembre 2026 à mars 2027 En raison des restrictions de visa, seules les demandes de la Suisse et de l'Union européenne seront examinées. Chez Marriott International, nous nous engageons à être un employeur à égalité des chances, accueillant tous et offrant l'accès aux possibilités. Nous favorisons activement un environnement où les origines uniques de nos associés sont appréciées et célébrées. Notre plus grande force réside dans le riche mélange de culture, de talent et d'expériences de nos associés. Nous sommes attachés à la non-discrimination sur toute base protégée, y compris le handicap, le statut d'ancien combattant ou toute autre base protégée par la loi applicable. W Hotels est la mission d'Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. Nous sommes un endroit où vivre. Nous sommes ici pour ouvrir les portes et ouvrir les esprits. Nous sommes constamment inspirés par de nouveaux visages et de nouvelles expériences. Un esprit à la hauteur de tout est à notre cœur et nous a rendus réputés pour avoir réinventé les normes du luxe à travers le monde. Quoi qu'il en soit, notre philosophie de la culture et du service apporte à nos hôtes des passions. Si vous êtes original, innovant et toujours regardant vers l'avenir de ce qui est possible, bienvenue à W Hotels. En rejoignant W Hotels, vous rejoignez un portefeuille de marques avec Marriott International. Soyez là où vous pouvez faire votre meilleur travail, commencer votre objectif, appartenir à une équipe mondiale incroyable, et devenir la meilleure version de vous.

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Enter and retrieve information contained in computer databases using a keyboard, mouse, or trackball to update records, files, reservations, and answer inquiries from guests. Transmit information or documents using a computer, mail, or facsimile machine. Operate standard office equipment other than computers. Prepare letters, memos, and other documents using word processing, spreadsheet, database, or presentation software. Handle incoming and outgoing mail, including date stamping and distributing incoming mail. Create and maintain computer- and paper-based filing and organization systems for records, reports, documents, etc. Compile, copy, sort, and file records of office activities, business transactions, and other activities. Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems.

Follow all company policies and procedures, ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests’ service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language, prepare and review written documents accurately and completely, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Visit in live here : W VERBIER Home

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCITING CHANCE TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM

As a Welcome Talent, you will be at the heart of daily departmental operations, serving as the ambassador for the W spirit, concept, and brand standards. Your mission? Greet our guests with enthusiasm and professionalism from check-in to check-out, creating a WOW effect at every step and anticipating their needs with finesse.

Your innate passion for our brand will enable you to advise guests on hotel services, stay conditions, and any other inquiries, ensuring an unforgettable experience.

You will also handle communication with guests via phone and email, and relay essential information to various hotel departments. Verifying services, invoicing, processing payments, and monitoring deferred payments will also be part of your responsibilities.

PROFILE

Previous experience in front desk operations in a 5-star hotel.

Fluent in French and English; proficiency in a third language is a plus.

Highly motivated and passionate about the realms of taste, sound, body, scene, and stance.

Attention to detail and commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.

Position to be filled for the Winter season : July 2026 to March 2027

Due to visa restrictions only applicants from Switzerland and European Union can be considered.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.  We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

W Hotels est la mission d'Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. Nous sommes un endroit où vivre. Nous sommes ici pour ouvrir les portes et ouvrir les esprits. SUMMARIO JOB
Il tuo ruolo di “Talent” a W Verbier Le Spa

Come Talent, si incarna il modo di vita W per i nostri ospiti. Lei è l'essenza stessa del marchio — appassionato, giocoso, caldo e accogliente nella personalità.

Perché unirsi a noi?

Una grande accessibilità a W VERBIER LE SPA – OPEN 365 GIORNI A ANNO

Principali responsabilità

• Assumere piena responsabilità per i risultati operativi e finanziari della Spa, assicurando la redditività e lo sviluppo della guida.

• Assicurare l'esperienza W in conformità con gli standard di marca e con gli standard LQA e FORBES.

• Sviluppare la strategia di marketing, costruire la lealtà dei membri, arricchire la programmazione, mantenere le relazioni con i clienti.

• Creare e sviluppare concetti di trattamento, partnership e offerte innovative.

• Analizzare le vendite e le relazioni finanziarie mensili; proporre raccomandazioni basate su mercato, stagionalità, concorrenza e tendenze.

• Costruire una struttura Talent efficace per mantenere i rapporti di produttività ed efficienza.

• Collabora con la leadership di marketing per sviluppare il piano annuale, coordinare le offerte promozionali. Assicurare visibilità interna ed esterna.

• Garantire un rigoroso rispetto delle normative in materia di igiene e sicurezza e degli standard di gruppo. Garanzia di manutenzione di attrezzature e impianti.

• Gestire richieste e reclami degli ospiti professionalmente.

• Implementare un programma di formazione strutturato per Talenti (personale permanente, stagionale, extra), condurre recensioni sulle prestazioni, gestire la pianificazione, la frequenza, il congedo e le assenze.

Il nostro punto di cinque passioni @ W

• Suono: l'atmosfera acustica, la musica e il suono alla Spa, per lenire, energizzare, elevare

• Gusto: sensazioni gustative, bevande di benessere, snack sani; un menù raffinato per risvegliare il palato

• Corpo: benessere fisico — trattamenti, fitness, massaggi, rituali corporei

• Scena: arredamento, stile, spettacolo — ambiente alpino, design, spazi WET®, l'attenzione ai dettagli

• Resistenza: atteggiamento, impegno — per l'ambiente, per il servizio, per l'esperienza umana, per l'autenticità

Criteri richiesti

Esperienza minima di 3 anni in un ruolo equivalente in una Spa di lusso.

Esperienza nell'ospitalità di lusso.

Fluente in francese e inglese.

L'esperienza in uno stabilimento stagionale è un vantaggio.

Grande attenzione al dettaglio e una vera passione per offrire un'esperienza memorabile.

A causa delle normative sui visti, saranno considerate solo le domande della Svizzera e dell'Unione Europea.

A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile.

La missione degli hotel è quella di accendere la curiosità, i mondi esplosi. Siamo un posto dove vivere la vita. Siamo qui per aprire porte e menti aperte. Siamo costantemente ispirati a nuovi volti e nuove esperienze. Uno spirito sintonizzato, up-for-anything è al nostro centro e ci ha resi noti per reinventare le norme del lusso in tutto il mondo. Qualunque sia la nostra cultura e la nostra filosofia di servizio che anima le passioni dei nostri ospiti. Se siete originali, innovativi e sempre alla ricerca del futuro di ciò che è possibile, benvenuti a W Hotels. Nell'unione di W Hotels, unisciti a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

jobs.title: Restaurant Supervisor
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Ensure staff is working together as a team to ensure optimum service and that guest needs are met. Inspect grooming and attire of staff, and rectify any deficiencies. Complete opening and closing duties including setting up necessary supplies and tools, cleaning all equipment and areas, locking doors, etc. Inspect storage areas for organization, use of FIFO, and cleanliness. Complete scheduled inventories and stock and requisition necessary supplies. Monitor dining rooms for seating availability, service, safety, and well being of guests. Complete work orders for maintenance repairs.

Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; and serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests’ service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; and identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
 • Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
 • Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.
 • Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
 • License or Certification: None

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.
Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.

In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

Ispezionare visivamente strumenti, attrezzature o macchine (ad esempio, per identificare difetti). Stand, sit, o camminare per un lungo periodo di tempo o per un intero turno di lavoro. Spostare, sollevare, trasportare, spingere, tirare e posizionare oggetti di peso inferiore o uguale a 50 libbre senza assistenza. Grasp, turn, e manipolare oggetti di varia dimensione e peso, che richiedono abilità motorie e coordinazione occhio-mano. Passare attraverso spazi stretti, limitati o elevati. Spostare le scale e/o le rampe di servizio. Raggiungere la testa sopra e sotto le ginocchia, tra cui piegatura, torsione, tirando e poggiando. Ensure staff is working together as a team to ensure optimum service and that guest needs are met. Inspect grooming and attire of staff, and rectify any deficiencies. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Überprüfen Sie die Pflege und die Kleidung des Personals und beheben Sie alle Mängel. Vollständige Öffnungs- und Schließaufgaben, einschließlich der Einrichtung notwendiger Vorräte und Werkzeuge, Reinigung aller Geräte und Bereiche, Schließtüren usw. Inspizieren Sie Lagerbereiche auf Organisation, Nutzung von FIFO und Sauberkeit. Führen Sie die geplanten Lagerbestände und die erforderlichen Vorräte aus. Überwachen Sie die Esszimmer auf Verfügbarkeit, Service, Sicherheit und Wohlbefinden der Gäste. Komplette Arbeitsaufträge für Wartungsreparaturen.

Unterstützen Sie das Management bei der Einstellung, Schulung, Planung, Bewertung, Beratung, Disziplinierung und Motivation und Coaching von Mitarbeitern; und dienen Sie als Vorbild und erster Ansprechpartner des Prozesses der Garantie für eine faire Behandlung / Open Door Policy. Befolgen sie alle unternehmens- und sicherheitsrichtlinien und -verfahren; melden sie unfälle, verletzungen und unsichere arbeitsbedingungen dem manager; und vervollständigen sie sicherheitsschulungen und zertifizierungen. Stellen Sie sicher, dass ein einheitliches und persönliches Erscheinungsbild sauber und professionell ist, wahren Sie die Vertraulichkeit der proprietären Informationen und schützen Sie die Vermögenswerte des Unternehmens. Begrüßen und anerkennen Sie alle Gäste nach Unternehmensstandards, antizipieren und adressieren Sie die Servicebedürfnisse der Gäste, unterstützen Sie Menschen mit Behinderungen und danken Sie den Gästen mit echter Wertschätzung. Sprechen Sie mit anderen mit einer klaren und professionellen Sprache. Entwickeln und pflegen Sie positive Arbeitsbeziehungen zu anderen, unterstützen Sie das Team, um gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen, und hören Sie zu und reagieren Sie angemessen auf die Anliegen anderer Mitarbeiter. Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Qualitätserwartungen und -standards; und Identifizierung, Empfehlung, Entwicklung und Implementierung neuer Wege zur Steigerung der organisatorischen Effizienz, Produktivität, Qualität, Sicherheit und / oder Kosteneinsparungen. Lesen und visuell überprüfen Sie Informationen in einer Vielzahl von Formaten (z. B. Kleingedrucktes). Visuelle Inspektion von Werkzeugen, Geräten oder Maschinen (z. B. zur Erkennung von Defekten). Stehen, sitzen oder gehen für einen längeren Zeitraum oder für eine ganze Arbeitsschicht. Bewegen, Heben, Tragen, Schieben, Ziehen und Platzieren von Objekten mit einem Gewicht von weniger als oder gleich 50 Pfund ohne Hilfe. Greifen, drehen und manipulieren Sie Objekte unterschiedlicher Größe und Gewicht, die Feinmotorik und Hand-Augen-Koordination erfordern. Bewegen Sie sich durch enge, begrenzte oder erhöhte Räume. Bewegen Sie Treppen und / oder Servicerampen auf und ab. Erreichen Sie über Kopf und unter den Knien, einschließlich Biegen, Verdrehen, Ziehen und Bücken. Führen Sie andere angemessene Aufgaben aus, wie von den Aufsichtsbehörden verlangt.

PREFERRE QUALIFIKATIONEN
• Ausbildung: High-School-Diplom oder GED gleichwertig.

• Aufsichtserfahrung: Mindestens 1 Jahr Aufsichtserfahrung.
• Lizenz oder Zertifizierung: Keine

Bei Marriott International sind wir bestrebt, ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit zu sein, alle willkommen zu heißen und Zugang zu Chancen zu bieten. RÉSUMÉ DE LA POSITION

Veiller à ce que le personnel travaille en équipe pour assurer un service optimal et à ce que les besoins des clients soient satisfaits. Inspecter le toilettage et la tenue du personnel, et corriger toute lacune. Compléter les fonctions d'ouverture et de fermeture, y compris la mise en place des fournitures et des outils nécessaires, le nettoyage de tous les équipements et des zones, les portes de verrouillage, etc. Inspecter les aires de stockage pour l'organisation, l'utilisation des FIFO et la propreté. Compléter les stocks et les stocks et demander les fournitures nécessaires. Surveillez les salles à manger pour les places, le service, la sécurité et le bien-être des clients. Commandes de travaux complètes pour les réparations d'entretien.

Aider la direction à embaucher, à former, à planifier, à évaluer, à conseiller, à discipliner, à motiver et à coacher les employés; servir de modèle et de premier point de contact pour le processus de la garantie d'un traitement équitable et de la politique de porte ouverte. Suivre toutes les politiques et procédures de l'entreprise et de sécurité; signaler les accidents, les blessures et les conditions de travail dangereuses au gestionnaire; et terminer la formation et les certifications en matière de sécurité. S'assurer que l'apparence personnelle et uniforme est propre et professionnelle, maintenir la confidentialité des renseignements exclusifs et protéger les biens de l'entreprise. Accueillir et reconnaître tous les invités selon les normes de l'entreprise, anticiper et répondre aux besoins de service des clients, aider les personnes handicapées, et remercier les invités avec une appréciation sincère. Parlez avec les autres en utilisant un langage clair et professionnel. Établir et maintenir des relations de travail positives avec les autres, appuyer l'équipe pour atteindre des objectifs communs et écouter et répondre adéquatement aux préoccupations des autres employés. Assurer le respect des attentes et des normes en matière de qualité; identifier, recommander, élaborer et mettre en oeuvre de nouvelles façons d'accroître l'efficacité organisationnelle, la productivité, la qualité, la sécurité ou les économies. Lire et vérifier visuellement l'information dans divers formats (p. ex. petits caractères). Inspecter visuellement les outils, l'équipement ou les machines (p. ex. pour déceler les défauts). Tenez-vous debout, asseyez-vous ou marchez pendant une longue période ou pendant tout un quart de travail. Déplacer, soulever, transporter, pousser, tirer et placer des objets pesant moins de 50 livres sans assistance. Grasp, tourner et manipuler des objets d'une taille et d'un poids différents, nécessitant de bonnes compétences motrices et une coordination main-oeil. Se déplacer dans des espaces étroits, confinés ou surélevés. Déplacer les escaliers et/ou les rampes de service. Atteindre au-dessus et au-dessous des genoux, y compris la flexion, la torsion, la traction et l'inclinaison. Exécuter d'autres tâches raisonnables à la demande des superviseurs.

QUALIFICATIONS PRÉFÉRÉES
• Éducation: diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent G.E.D.
• Expérience professionnelle connexe : Au moins 2 années d'expérience professionnelle connexe.
• Expérience en matière de surveillance: Au moins 1 an d'expérience en matière de surveillance.
• Licence ou certification: Aucun

jobs.title: Hotel Cleanliness Supervisor
jobs.description:
Main tasks and competencies:
 The Hotel Cleanliness Supervisor – Late Shift is responsible for overseeing evening housekeeping operations to ensure cleanliness, safety, and readiness of all assigned rooms, cleanliness of all public area’s extra requests, organization of all housekeeping designated offices and storage rooms.
 This role supervises housekeeping staff during evening hours, inspects completed work, coordinates shift assignments, and responds to urgent cleaning and delivery requests. Ensure a smooth, detailed and all preparations for handover to shift operations is prepared.
 Key Responsibilities

• Supervise housekeeping staff during late shift operations.

• Assign nightly cleaning schedules, priorities, and work areas.

• Inspect guest rooms, public spaces, restrooms, hallways, and assigned areas for cleanliness and presentation.

• Ensure all cleaning tasks are completed according to company standards and timelines.

• Respond to urgent housekeeping requests, spills, sanitation issues, special cleaning needs and office checks.

• Monitor attendance, productivity, and staff performance during shift hours.

• Train and coach staff on cleaning procedures, equipment usage, and safety practices.

• Maintain adequate stock of linen, cleaning supplies, and housekeeping equipment for the next shift.

• Report maintenance concerns, hazards, or repair issues promptly.

• Ensure compliance with sanitation, infection control, and workplace safety standards.

• Complete shift reports, document handover notes, collect delivery notes, and if incident documentation.

• Support emergency cleaning needs with other departments if needed in the public area

• Foster teamwork, accountability, and quality service.
 The primary responsibility of this role is to maintain impeccably clean guest rooms and public areas, support smooth hotel operations during each shift, and contribute to an exceptional guest experience that ensures guest satisfaction.
 Important:

• This position is for daily late shift

• High level in German (B2)

• Swiss B or C permit OR EU citizenship

Principali compiti e competenze:
L’Hotel Cleanliness Supervisor – Late Shift è responsabile della supervisione delle operazioni di pulizia serale per garantire la pulizia, la sicurezza e la disponibilità di tutte le camere assegnate, la pulizia di tutte le richieste extra dell’area pubblica, l’organizzazione di tutti gli uffici di pulizia e le sale di stoccaggio designate.
Questo ruolo supervisiona il personale di pulizia durante le ore serali, ispeziona il lavoro completato, coordina le assegnazioni di turno e risponde alle richieste di pulizia e consegna urgenti. Assicurare un liscio, dettagliato e tutti i preparativi per la consegna a turni sono preparati.
Principali responsabilità

• Personale di pulizia eccellente durante le operazioni di turno tardivo.

• Assegnare programmi di pulizia notturna, priorità e aree di lavoro.

• Ispezionare camere, spazi pubblici, bagni, corridoi e aree assegnate per pulizia e presentazione.

• Assicurarsi che tutte le attività di pulizia siano completate secondo gli standard aziendali e le tempistiche.

• Risponde a richieste di pulizia urgenti, fuoriuscite, problemi sanitari, esigenze di pulizia speciali e controlli di ufficio.

• Monitorare la frequenza, la produttività e le prestazioni del personale durante le ore di turno.

• Personale di treni e pullman per le procedure di pulizia, l'uso delle attrezzature e le pratiche di sicurezza.

• Mantenere adeguati stock di biancheria, forniture di pulizia e attrezzature di pulizia per il prossimo turno.

• Segnala immediatamente problemi di manutenzione, pericoli o problemi di riparazione.

• Assicurare la conformità con i servizi igienici, il controllo delle infezioni e gli standard di sicurezza sul posto di lavoro.

• Rapporti completi di turni, note di consegna del documento, raccogliere le note di consegna, e se la documentazione incidente.

• Sostenere le esigenze di pulizia di emergenza con altri dipartimenti, se necessario nell'area pubblica

• Promuovere il lavoro di squadra, la responsabilità e il servizio di qualità.
La responsabilità primaria di questo ruolo è quella di mantenere le camere e le aree pubbliche perfettamente pulite, sostenere le operazioni alberghiere durante ogni turno e contribuire ad un'esperienza eccezionale degli ospiti che garantisce la soddisfazione degli ospiti.

• Questa posizione è per il turno di notte

Diese Rolle überwacht das Hauswirtschaftspersonal während der Abendstunden, überprüft die abgeschlossenen Arbeiten, koordiniert Schichtaufgaben und reagiert auf dringende Reinigungs- und Lieferanfragen. Sicherstellen, dass eine reibungslose, detaillierte und alle Vorbereitungen für die Übergabe an Schichtvorgänge vorbereitet werden.
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Beaufsichtigen Sie das Hauswirtschaftspersonal bei Spätschichtbetrieben.

• Weisen Sie nächtliche Reinigungspläne, Prioritäten und Arbeitsbereiche zu.

• Inspizieren Sie Gästezimmer, öffentliche Räume, Toiletten, Flure und zugewiesene Bereiche auf Sauberkeit und Präsentation.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Reinigungsaufgaben gemäß den Unternehmensstandards und Zeitplänen durchgeführt werden.

• Reagieren Sie auf dringende Reinigungsanfragen, Verschüttungen, Hygieneprobleme, spezielle Reinigungsbedürfnisse und Bürokontrollen.

• Überwachen Sie die Anwesenheit, Produktivität und die Leistung des Personals während der Schichtzeiten.

• Zug- und Reisebuspersonal für Reinigungsverfahren, Gebrauch der Ausrüstung und Sicherheitspraktiken.

• Halten Sie ausreichend Bettwäsche, Reinigungsmittel und Haushaltsgeräte für die nächste Schicht.

• Melden Sie umgehend Wartungsbedenken, Gefahren oder Reparaturprobleme.

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Hygiene-, Infektions- und Sicherheitsstandards am Arbeitsplatz.

• Füllen Sie Schichtberichte aus, dokumentieren Sie Übergabehinweise, sammeln Sie Lieferscheine und dokumentieren Sie Vorfälle.

• Unterstützung des Notfallreinigungsbedarfs mit anderen Abteilungen, wenn im öffentlichen Bereich benötigt

• Förderung von Teamarbeit, Rechenschaftspflicht und Qualitätsservice.
Die hauptverantwortung dieser rolle besteht darin, einwandfrei saubere gästezimmer und öffentliche bereiche zu erhalten, den reibungslosen hotelbetrieb während jeder schicht zu unterstützen und zu einem außergewöhnlichen gästeerlebnis beizutragen, das die gästezufriedenheit gewährleistet.

• Schweizer B oder C Erlaubnis oder EU-Staatsbürgerschaft

jobs.title: Hotel Cleanliness Expert
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.
 JW Marriott is part of Marriott International's luxury portfolio and consists of more than 100 beautiful properties in gateway cities and distinctive resort locations around the world. JW believes our associates come first. Because if you’re happy, our guests will be happy. JW Marriott associates are confident, innovative, genuine, intuitive, and carry on the legacy of the brand’s namesake and company founder, J.Willard Marriott. descriptionByLocale.fr: RÉSUMÉ DE LA POSITION Nos emplois ne sont pas simplement de donner aux invités une chambre propre et un lit fraîchement fait. Au lieu de cela, nous voulons construire une expérience mémorable et unique. Nos experts en environnement invités sont qualifiés dans un large éventail de fonctions d'entretien ménager avec la responsabilité de maintenir l'apparence et la propreté de tout l'hôtel. Ils sont habilités à se déplacer dans leur espace et à faire ce qui doit être fait. Qu'il s'agisse de livrer des demandes de clients, de stocker des chariots, de nettoyer des salles et des espaces publics, ou d'autres responsabilités similaires, l'expert en environnement invité s'assure que les espaces de l'hôtel contribuent à créer une grande expérience des clients. jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Inspect guest rooms, public areas, pool, etc. after being cleaned by Housekeeper to ensure quality standards. Run sold room reports, verify room status, determine discrepant rooms, prioritize room cleaning, and update status of departing guest rooms. Assist Housekeeping management in managing daily activities. Act as a liaison to coordinate the efforts of Housekeeping, Engineering, Front Office, and Laundry. Document and resolve issues with discrepant rooms with the Front Desk. Prepare, distribute, and communicate changes in room assignments. Communicate issues to next shift. Complete required paperwork.

Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Move, lift, carry, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 55 pounds without assistance and in excess of 55 pounds with assistance. Ability to push and pull a loaded housekeeping cart and other work-related machinery over sloping and uneven surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Stand, sit, kneel, or walk for an extended period across an entire work shift. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
 • Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
 • Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
 • Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
 • License or Certification: None

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.
Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.

In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

SUMMARIO POSIZIONE Ispezionare le camere, le aree pubbliche, la piscina, ecc dopo essere stato pulito dal Housekeeper per garantire standard di qualità. Eseguire rapporti di camera venduti, verificare lo stato della camera, determinare camere discrepant, priorità pulizia della camera, e aggiornare lo stato delle camere in partenza. Assistere la gestione della pulizia nella gestione delle attività quotidiane. Agire come collegamento per coordinare gli sforzi di pulizia, ingegneria, ufficio anteriore e lavanderia. Documentare e risolvere i problemi con camere discrepant con la reception. Preparare, distribuire e comunicare i cambiamenti nelle assegnazioni delle camere. Comunicare le questioni al prossimo turno. Documenti richiesti completi. Gestione assist nell'assunzione, formazione, pianificazione, valutazione, consulenza, disciplining, e motivare e coaching dipendenti. Seguire tutte le politiche e procedure aziendali e di sicurezza; segnalare eventuali problemi di manutenzione, rischi di sicurezza, incidenti o lesioni; formazione completa e certificazioni di sicurezza. Assicurare l'aspetto uniforme e personale sono puliti e professionali; mantenere la riservatezza delle informazioni proprietarie; proteggere le attività aziendali. Accogliere e riconoscere tutti gli ospiti secondo gli standard aziendali; anticipare e soddisfare le esigenze di servizio degli ospiti; assistere gli individui con disabilità; ringraziare gli ospiti con apprezzamento autentico. Parla con gli altri usando linguaggio chiaro e professionale. Sviluppare e mantenere rapporti di lavoro positivi con gli altri; ascoltare e rispondere adeguatamente alle preoccupazioni di altri dipendenti. Assicurare l'adesione a aspettative e standard di qualità. Spostare, sollevare, trasportare e posizionare oggetti di peso inferiore o uguale a 55 libbre senza assistenza e in eccesso di 55 libbre con assistenza. Possibilità di spingere e tirare un carrello di pulizia caricato e altri macchinari legati al lavoro su superfici scorrevoli e irregolari. Raggiungere la testa sopra e sotto le ginocchia, tra cui piegatura, torsione, tirando e poggiando. In piedi, sedersi, inginocchiarsi o camminare per un periodo prolungato attraverso un intero turno di lavoro. Grasp, turn, e manipolare oggetti di varia dimensione e peso, che richiedono abilità motorie e coordinazione occhio-mano. Immettere e individuare informazioni relative al lavoro utilizzando computer e/o sistemi di vendita. Leggere e verificare visivamente le informazioni in una varietà di formati (ad esempio, piccola stampa). Eseguire altri ragionevoli compiti di lavoro come richiesto dai Supervisori. QUALIFICAZIONE PREFERRATA
• Istruzione: diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente G.E.D.
• Esperienza di lavoro correlata: almeno 1 anno di esperienza lavorativa correlata.
• Esperienza di supervisione: almeno 1 anno di esperienza di supervisione.
• Licenza o Certificazione: Nessuno A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile. In oltre 100 strutture premiate in tutto il mondo, The Ritz-Carlton Signore e Signori creano esperienze così eccezionali che a lungo dopo un ospite soggiorna con noi, l'esperienza rimane con loro. Attrarre i migliori professionisti dell’ospitalità del mondo che curano i ricordi per tutta la vita, crediamo che tutti ci riescano quando hanno il potere di essere creativi, riflessivi e compassionevoli. Ogni giorno, abbiamo stabilito lo standard per il servizio di lusso raro e speciale in tutto il mondo e ci orgogliosi di fornire l'eccellenza nella cura e nel comfort dei nostri ospiti. Il vostro ruolo sarà quello di garantire che i “Gold Standards” di The Ritz-Carlton vengano consegnati con gentilezza e con pensiero ogni giorno. Gli Gold Standards sono la base di The Ritz-Carlton e sono ciò che ci guida ogni giorno per essere meglio del prossimo. E 'questa fondazione e la nostra convinzione che la nostra cultura spinge il successo con cui The Ritz Carlton ha guadagnato la reputazione di leader di marca globale nell'ospitalità di lusso. Nell'ambito del nostro team, imparerai ed esemplificherai gli standard dell'oro, come la nostra promessa dei dipendenti, il credo e i nostri valori di servizio. E la nostra promessa è che offriamo la possibilità di essere orgogliosi del lavoro che fate e con cui lavorate. Nell'unione con The Ritz-Carlton, ti unisci a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

Entwickeln und pflegen Sie positive Arbeitsbeziehungen zu anderen; hören Sie zu und reagieren Sie angemessen auf die Anliegen anderer Mitarbeiter. Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Qualitätserwartungen und Standards. Bewegen, Heben, Tragen und Platzieren von Objekten mit einem Gewicht von weniger als oder gleich 55 Pfund ohne Hilfe und über 55 Pfund mit Hilfe. Fähigkeit, einen beladenen haushaltswagen und andere arbeitsbezogene maschinen über schräge und unebene oberflächen zu schieben und zu ziehen. Greifen, drehen und manipulieren Sie Objekte unterschiedlicher Größe und Gewicht, die Feinmotorik und Hand-Augen-Koordination erfordern. jobs.title: Global Managing Director, Lefay
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Global Managing Director – Lefay Wellness Resorts provides strategic and enterprise leadership for the long-term stewardship, evolution, and global expansion of Lefay, a luxury wellness resort brand. This role is accountable for safeguarding the brand’s founding philosophy and proprietary wellness methodologies while driving sustainable growth, financial performance, and asset value creation through a disciplined, asset-light model.

Operating within a Joint Venture structure, the Managing Director partners closely with the Founders, Joint Venture Board, and Marriott’s global and regional functions to ensure the brand’s standards, operating model, and development pipeline are scalable, compliant, and aligned across markets. The role requires strong governance, stakeholder alignment, and the ability to lead effectively within a complex, matrixed organization.

Leveraging a deliberately lean organizational model, the Managing Director provides leadership and strategic oversight across properties, including influence over General Manager selection and performance, while ensuring alignment to Lefay’s luxury positioning, wellness credibility, and guest experience standards.

The position reports to the JV Board.

Scope

• Location: Switzerland

• This position will be required to travel frequently

Key Responsibilities

• Protect and scale Lefay’s wellness philosophy and proprietary methodologies by codifying and embedding the brand’s integrated wellness framework, encompassing its scientific underpinnings, treatment methodologies, programme design, and translation into consistent guest experiences across diverse global markets.

• Partner with ownership and development teams to grow a disciplined global pipeline by identifying and evaluating target markets and opportunities, encompassing feasibility assessment, deal structuring support, and alignment of all new developments to Lefay’s brand positioning, design philosophy, and financial performance expectations.

• Drive alignment across Marriott, the Joint Venture Board, owners, and brand stakeholders by establishing and leading governance and decision-making frameworks, encompassing structured forums, clear roles and accountabilities, and consistent communication to enable prioritisation and execution within a complex matrixed environment.

• Oversee brand standards, guest experience, and wellness programming globally by defining and governing Lefay’s end-to-end brand framework, encompassing brand pillars and foundational elements, tone of voice and positioning, and the full guest journey from pre-arrival through post-stay engagement.

• Serve as the primary interface with the Joint Venture Board of Directors by leading strategic engagement and performance reporting, encompassing regular updates on financial performance, development pipeline progress, brand evolution, and alignment on long-term strategic priorities.

• Lead governance processes including strategy, budgeting, and reporting by establishing and maintaining enterprise planning and performance frameworks, encompassing annual and long-range strategic plans, budget and forecasting cycles, and disciplined reporting against agreed KPIs and investment objectives

• Embed compliance with Marriott policies and regulatory frameworks by integrating required standards and controls into the operating model, encompassing oversight across all properties and developments, adherence to legal and governance requirements, and proactive identification and mitigation of risk across jurisdictions.

• Own full P&L accountability including forecasting and capital planning by driving financial performance across the portfolio, encompassing revenue and profitability optimisation, budget development and reforecasting, and capital allocation decisions aligned to long-term asset value creation.

• Optimize a lean Joint Venture operating model by leveraging Marriott’s global and regional infrastructure, encompassing clear delineation of responsibilities across shared services, efficient resource allocation, and avoidance of unnecessary above-property duplication.

• Oversee design, technical standards, and sustainability integration by guiding concept development and execution across the portfolio, encompassing alignment to Lefay’s aesthetic and wellness positioning, technical and operational standards, and the integration of sustainability principles into both development and ongoing operations.

• Lead global stakeholder engagement with owners, developers, and partners by building and maintaining strategic relationships, encompassing alignment on brand expectations, performance outcomes, and long-term growth opportunities across the Lefay portfolio.

• Build and lead a high-performing leadership team across functions by defining required capabilities and structure, encompassing talent selection and development across brand, design, and finance, and embedding a culture aligned to Lefay’s values, standards, and performance expectations.

• Lead through influence within a complex matrix organisation by aligning cross-functional Marriott teams across regions and disciplines, encompassing collaboration, prioritisation, and delivery of shared objectives without direct line authority.

• Sustain strong relationships to drive long-term brand and financial performance by engaging consistently with owners, Joint Venture partners, and internal stakeholders, encompassing alignment to strategic priorities, investment objectives, and sustained brand integrity over time.

Additional Duties

• Uphold the highest standards of business ethics and compliance with Marriott policies.

• Champion cross-functional collaboration and team excellence, building a purpose-driven, peak performance culture across EMEA hotels and offices.
 Candidate Profile

Required

• 15+ years of senior leadership experience within upper‑luxury hospitality, lifestyle, or wellness‑adjacent brands, ideally in resort environments.

• Demonstrated credibility in the wellness space, paired with the judgment to operate as an enterprise business leader rather than a functional specialist.

• Proven success leading complex, multi‑entity or Joint Venture structures with Board‑level accountability.

• Extensive experience operating in multicultural, matrixed, and internationally regulated environments, including Europe.

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate market and business trends and translate strategy into large‑scale execution

• College degree required

Preferred

• Demonstrated strong strategic and commercial leadership, balancing long-term vision with disciplined execution and bringing deep financial acumen across P&L ownership, budgeting, forecasting, and capital planning.

• Operated effectively within complex, matrixed and Joint Venture environments, influencing outcomes without direct authority and aligning diverse stakeholders including Boards, owners, partners, and cross-functional teams.

• Exhibited credible and influential leadership, combining entrepreneurial brand stewardship with enterprise-level governance, supported by sound judgment, strong negotiation capability, and fact-based decision making.

• Built, led, and developed high-performing teams within lean organisational models, demonstrating the ability to prioritise, problem-solve, and deliver results in fast-paced, complex, and ambiguous environments.

• Demonstrated strong governance, risk, and compliance capability, operating with high integrity and accountability across multi-jurisdictional environments and leading transformation while maintaining operational stability.

• Built trusted relationships and aligned stakeholders globally, combining exceptional communication and partnership capability with a global mindset and a purpose-driven leadership style aligned to wellness values, resilience, and personal accountability.

• Graduate degree preferred, such as MBA or equivalent

Key Competencies

• Curious : Open to new ideas, seeks diverse viewpoints, and explores better ways of working.

• Courageous : Challenges norms, takes ownership, and leads change.

• Connected : Builds meaningful relationships and fosters collaboration across boundaries.

Enterprise Leadership & Peak Performance Capabilities

• Demonstrates strong commercial judgement and financial acumen, applying insight to drive sustainable results and enterprise value across a complex, multi brand and multimarket environment.

• Operates effectively in ambiguity, complexity, and change, maintaining clarity of direction and momentum while balancing competing priorities, commitments, and decision horizons.

• Thinks and acts with an enterprise mindset, prioritising end to end outcomes over functional or local optimisation and making disciplined trade-offs that protect brand integrity—particularly within luxury—while optimising enterprise value.

• Sets clear strategic direction and translates vision into priorities, commitments, and measurable outcomes through others, across a highly matrixed and geographically dispersed organisation.

• Builds strong, trust based stakeholder partnerships across senior regional leaders, owners and franchise partners, hotel leadership, brand and luxury platforms, and discipline teams; influences without authority and aligns diverse and sometimes competing interests toward shared enterprise outcomes.

• Leads inclusively across diverse cultures, geographies, and perspectives, demonstrating strong cultural fluency and situational awareness while reinforcing common purpose, values, and standards.

• Creates the conditions for sustained high performance, holding high standards of accountability while enabling focus, alignment, and continuous improvement at scale.

Leadership Approach & Expectations

• Leads through vision and values, ensuring decisions and behaviours consistently reflect organisational purpose, brand standards, and enterprise leadership expectations.

• Leads as a coach, adopting a coaching mindset that builds capability, strengthens judgement, and multiplies impact across teams, markets, and stakeholder groups.

• Embeds continuous, real time coaching and feedback, supporting individuals and teams to adapt, learn, and perform at their best in complex and evolving environments.

• Drives and sustains change, modelling resilience, composure, and confidence while removing barriers and accelerating progress across multiple geographies and stakeholder systems.

• Applies sound judgement and enterprise level decision making, integrating multiple perspectives, data, and contextual insight to navigate complexity and make effective trade-offs.

• Delivers results through others, setting clear expectations, establishing individual and collective accountability, and ensuring follow through across a matrixed operating model.

• Invests actively in talent and succession, developing current and future leaders capable of operating at scale and representing the enterprise across brands and markets.

Contribution to Peak Performance

• Champions a coaching led performance culture, where trust, learning, and honest dialogue enable sustained performance across diverse teams, brands, and geographies.

• Connects individual and team contributions to enterprise priorities and outcomes, reinforcing ownership, accountability, and clarity of purpose in a complex operating environment.

• Strengthens organisational capability by scaling impact through people, enabling leaders and teams to perform effectively without reliance on personal heroics.

• Shapes a culture of continuous improvement, resilience, and disciplined execution, ensuring the enterprise delivers consistent results while protecting brand integrity—particularly within luxury—and meeting commitments across markets.

We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, such as disability and veteran status, or any other basis covered under applicable law.
