jobs.title: Cook-Apprentice
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to determine if they have been cooked sufficiently. Monitor food quality while preparing food. Set-up and break down work station. Serve food in proper portions onto proper receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen area, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of the temperature of appliances and food.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
 • Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
 • Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
 • Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
 • License or Certification: None

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.  We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.
Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.

In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

Preparare e cucinare il cibo secondo ricette, standard di qualità, standard di presentazione e la lista di controllo di preparazione del cibo. Preparare cibi freddi. Lavorare forni, fornelli, griglie, microonde e friggitrici. Provare gli alimenti per determinare se sono stati cucinati abbastanza. Monitorare la qualità del cibo durante la preparazione del cibo. Impostare e abbattere la stazione di lavoro. Servire il cibo in porzioni adeguate su ricettacoli appropriati. Lavare e disinfettare zona cucina, tavoli, strumenti, coltelli e attrezzature. Controllare e garantire la correttezza della temperatura degli apparecchi e del cibo.

Seguire tutte le politiche e le procedure aziendali e di sicurezza; segnalare esigenze di manutenzione, incidenti, infortuni e condizioni di lavoro non sicure al gestore; formazione completa e certificazioni di sicurezza. Parla con gli altri usando linguaggio chiaro e professionale. Assicurare l'adesione a aspettative e standard di qualità. Stand, sit, o camminare per un lungo periodo di tempo o per un intero turno di lavoro. Raggiungere la testa sopra e sotto le ginocchia, tra cui piegatura, torsione, tirando e poggiando. Spostare, sollevare, trasportare, spingere, tirare e posizionare oggetti di peso inferiore o uguale a 25 libbre senza assistenza. • Esperienza di lavoro correlata: almeno 1 anno di esperienza lavorativa correlata.
• Esperienza di supervisione: Nessuna esperienza di supervisione.

POSITION SUMMARY

Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to determine if they have been cooked sufficiently. Monitor food quality while preparing food. Set-up and break down work station. Serve food in proper portions onto proper receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen area, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of the temperature of appliances and food.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
• Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
• Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
• Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
• License or Certification: None

Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.
Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. Bereiten Sie Zutaten für das Kochen, einschließlich Portionierung, Hacken und Lagerung von Lebensmitteln. Frisches Obst und Gemüse waschen und schälen. Wiegen, messen und mischen Sie Zutaten. Bereiten und kochen Sie Lebensmittel nach Rezepturen, Qualitätsstandards, Präsentationsstandards und Checkliste für die Zubereitung von Lebensmitteln. Bereiten Sie kalte Lebensmittel zu. Betrieb von Öfen, Öfen, Grills, Mikrowellen und Friteusen. Testen Sie Lebensmittel, um festzustellen, ob sie ausreichend gekocht wurden. Überwachen Sie die Lebensmittelqualität während der Zubereitung von Lebensmitteln. Einrichtung und Abbau von Arbeitsplätzen. Servieren Sie Essen in richtigen Portionen auf richtige Behälter. Waschen und Desinfizieren Sie Küchenbereich, Tische, Werkzeuge, Messer und Geräte. Überprüfen und gewährleisten Sie die Richtigkeit der Temperatur von Geräten und Lebensmitteln.

Befolgen sie alle unternehmens- und sicherheitsrichtlinien und -verfahren; melden sie wartungsbedürfnisse, unfälle, verletzungen und unsichere arbeitsbedingungen an den manager; schließen sie sicherheitsschulungen und zertifizierungen ab. Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Qualitätserwartungen und Standards. Stehen, sitzen oder gehen für einen längeren Zeitraum oder für eine ganze Arbeitsschicht. Erreichen Sie über Kopf und unter den Knien, einschließlich Biegen, Verdrehen, Ziehen und Bücken. Bewegen, Heben, Tragen, Schieben, Ziehen und Platzieren von Objekten mit einem Gewicht von weniger als oder gleich 25 Pfund ohne Hilfe. Führen Sie andere angemessene Aufgaben aus, wie von den Aufsichtsbehörden verlangt.

RÉSUMÉ DE LA POSITION

Préparer les ingrédients pour la cuisson, y compris la portion, la découpe et le stockage des aliments. Lavez et épluchez les fruits et légumes frais. Peser, mesurer et mélanger les ingrédients. Préparer et cuire les aliments selon les recettes, les normes de qualité, les normes de présentation et la liste de contrôle de préparation des aliments. Préparez des aliments froids. Utiliser des fours, des cuisinières, des grillades, des micro-ondes et des friteuses. Tester les aliments pour déterminer s'ils ont été suffisamment cuits. Surveiller la qualité des aliments pendant la préparation des aliments. Installation et démantèlement du poste de travail. Servir les aliments en portions appropriées sur les récipients appropriés. Laver et désinfecter la cuisine, les tables, les outils, les couteaux et l'équipement. Vérifier et assurer l'exactitude de la température des appareils et des aliments.

Suivre toutes les politiques et procédures de l'entreprise et de la sécurité; signaler les besoins en matière d'entretien, les accidents, les blessures et les conditions de travail dangereuses au gestionnaire; terminer la formation et les certifications en matière de sécurité. Veiller à ce que l'apparence personnelle et uniforme soit propre et professionnelle; maintenir la confidentialité des renseignements exclusifs; protéger les biens de l'entreprise. Parlez avec les autres en utilisant un langage clair et professionnel. Établir et maintenir des relations de travail positives avec les autres; appuyer l'équipe pour atteindre des objectifs communs; écouter les préoccupations des autres employés et y répondre de façon appropriée. Assurer le respect des attentes et des normes de qualité. Tenez-vous debout, asseyez-vous ou marchez pendant une longue période ou pendant tout un quart de travail. Atteindre au-dessus et au-dessous des genoux, y compris la flexion, la torsion, la traction et l'inclinaison. Déplacer, soulever, transporter, pousser, tirer et placer des objets pesant moins de 25 livres sans assistance. Exécuter d'autres tâches raisonnables à la demande des superviseurs.

As part of our team, you will take orders and serve guests in a cheerful, enthusiastic, professional and meticulous manner.

As an In-Room-Dining (Room-Service) Chef de Rang, you will join our afternoon/evening team . Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

At our Brasserie 1519 restaurant, you will take orders and serve our guests with enthusiasm, professionalism, and creativity, while using appropriate sales techniques.

Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.
